title: Access Graph Evaluator and Unified Enforcement Gateway for Runtime/API/Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an Access Graph Evaluator and a lightweight Unified Enforcement Gateway that provide consistent authorization decisions across hosted API, Dedicated runtime, and Console. This ticket covers evaluator semantics, evaluation cache strategy, audit-record format, SSO/SAML integration hooks for principal mapping, and an admin control surface for emergency policy overrides and explainability traces.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator accepts policy graph + request context and returns allow/deny with explainability tokens within 5ms p50 for cached decisions
Enforcement Gateway supports gRPC and HTTP middleware for runtime and REST endpoints for Console with pluggable fallbacks
Audit logs emitted in structured JSON with standard fields (actor, subject, action, resource, decision, policy_version, trace_id) and forwarded to audit-sink within 2s
SAML/SSO principal mapping hooks implemented and documented with examples for Azure AD and Okta
Admin control panel integration: can execute a simulated decision, view explainability trace, and perform temporary policy bypasses gated by MFA and logged as high-severity audit events
design_notes: Choose access graph representation (subject-role-resource-edge) to support transitive role membership and resource inheritance
Evaluation engine will compile high-frequency slices into an optimized decision trie for fast path vs. fallback generic PDP
Caching strategy: short-lived cache keyed by (principal_hash, resource_hash, action, policy_version). TTL adaptive based on observed mutation rate from policy store
Audit format aligned with observability pipeline: JSON schema v1.2; include decision latency, source (api/runtime/console), capacity-tier, and request token cost estimate
Fallback behaviour: when evaluator unavailable, gateway uses stale decision if <10s and service-tier is dedicated; otherwise return 503 and trigger failover to secondary evaluator cluster
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Prototype evaluator as a stateless service that reads policies from policy-store and exposes Evaluate(principal, action, resource)
Phase 2: Implement enforcement gateway as middleware adapters for runtime (gRPC interceptor), API (Express/Go middleware), and Console (proxy layer)
Phase 3: Add caching layer (redis-backed) and compile-to-trie fast-path for top 1000 decision signatures
Phase 4: Wire audit exporter to audit-sink (Kafka -> warehouse) and add enrichment (user-org, geo, capacity-tier)
Phase 5: Integrate SSO principal mapping and admin UI controls; run end-to-end tests and security review
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cache staleness leading to incorrect allows. Mitigation: conservative TTL, policy-change invalidation push from policy-store, and audit sampling to detect drift
Risk: Performance regression in hot paths. Mitigation: compile hot slices, run benchmark harness against real traffic shapes, and provide per-model latency budgets in Console
Risk: Admin bypass abused. Mitigation: require MFA + auditable justification field + automatic rollback timer
Risk: SAML mapping ambiguity across IdPs. Mitigation: provide config mapping templates for Okta/Azure and a mapping validation tool in Console

notes_from_engineering: Prototype uses WASM-based policy eval for portability between Dedicated and Private deployments
Prefer Redis Cluster for LRU TTL caching in hosted; allow optional in-memory LRU for Private lightweight installs
Expose Explain() API that returns matched rule ids + evaluation path for UI trace. Limit trace size to 2KB by default
